notes: 전체 테이블은 5개 개인 콘솔과 공용 시장/식민지/주사위/충전/시작자 영역으로 표현한다. 플레이 인원에 따라 사용하지 않는 콘솔을 숨긴다.
개인 콘솔의 12개 섹터마다 정박 위치 0–1장, 배치 함선 0–무제한 겹침 스택, 선택적 콜로니 덮어쓰기를 분리한다. 배치 스택에 임의의 최대 장수를 두지 않는다.
자원 트랙은 크레딧·수입·승점 각각 0–40 포인터와 40 초과 charge marker를 분리 저장한다. 총량과 포인터 위치가 모순되면 원상태를 보존하고 자동 보정하지 않는다.
공용 shipyard는 레벨별 6장 공개 제안과 보충용 숨은 덱을 분리하며, 콜로니 12장은 오름차순 공개되고 구매 후 보충되지 않는다.
SVG의 카드·토큰 윤곽은 위치 표시용 도식일 뿐 실제 패/자원 초기화가 아니다. 전체 턴 중단 위치와 모든 플레이어의 굴림 배분 완료 상태는 JSON 계약으로 보존하며 규칙을 자동 실행하지 않는다.

structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: 2–5 players; 5 consoles; 60 starting ships in five sets of 12; 132 ships (48/48/36); 12 colonies; 30 charges; 2 d6; 12 sectors; three 0–40 resource tracks.

one upright station and upside-down deployed stacks per sector; 18 face-up offers (6 per level); 12 face-up colonies ascending/no refill; active and passive players independently allocate sum or individual dice; optional one-card purchase and shipyard refill.
40 VP triggers current-round completion with equal turns; ties continue full extra rounds; charge markers encode resource totals beyond 40 and 80.

playerAccentColors.meaning: diagram-only seat distinction; not a physical color assignment

commandConsoles.contains: 12 numbered sectors and three resource tracks

startingShipSets.setup: each player lays one starting ship into each matching numbered sector

shipCards.hiddenDeckRemaining: record exact or unknown; do not derive from total if identities are unknown

sharedState.shipyardOffers: 18 individually identified public offers, six per level; each purchased slot links to its source level deck for refill
sharedState.colonyMarket: 12 ordered public cards; each removed card leaves a vacancy and is never replenished
sharedState.chargeTokenInventory: 30 physical tokens with exact-known-or-unknown locations; never infer unobserved zero

turnState.allocationsByPlayer: one record per active/passive player: selected sectorNumbers (duplicates allowed for doubles), resolved flag, rewards/activations already resolved, unresolved action note
turnState.activeAndPassiveResolution: preserve per-player partial progress because all players allocate after the active roll

endGame.trigger: any player reaches at least 40 VP
endGame.tieBreak: continue full extra rounds until a highest score is unique

setupState.startingShipSetsPlaced: 12 per participating player in matching sectors
setupState.resourceMarkers: record each initial marker position; do not assume initialized values when reconstructing a mid-setup photo
setupState.randomLevel1StartCard: drawn per player, paid by cost, placed in matching sector and replaces/deploys prior card; preserve card identities and setup progress
setupState.turnOrderResourceBonuses: record actually assigned values by seat; no automatic application

preservation.unknowns: retain null/unknown card identities, quantities, markers, allocations and phase without dropping physical objects
preservation.projections: static SVG placeholders are not actual current cards/tokens; state is stored separately
preservation.gameRules: asset identifies state needed to resume; it does not validate legal actions, resolve rewards or advance turns

includes: unbounded deployed ship stacks and colony overlay semantics
three resource tracks and overflow marker zones per player
18 face-up shipyard offers and three hidden level decks
diagram-only player accents are not stored player colors; overflow marker illustration is open-ended, not a four-token capacity
notClaimed: complete card-by-card catalog or card-effect automation

auxiliaryAssets.purpose: Five player command-console instances plus the complete shared setup zones; static schematic, not a dealt game state.
